payload.title: calendar view renders this week's events
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toHaveCount(3)

Locator: getByTestId('calendar-event')
Expected: 3
Received: 0

note: Zero events rendered looks like a date-range calculation bug — querying the wrong week — but the calendar-events endpoint returned a 504 gateway timeout on both attempts; the backend never answered in time, so there was no event data to render regardless of which week was requested. The roughly 18% historical rate tracks a gateway that periodically times out under load, not the calendar view's date logic.
